items.current: description: "El-Ahsa'nın tarım ürünleri arasında hurmadan sonra ikinci sırada gelen El-Ahsa misket limonunu (yerel adıyla lomi) tanıyın. Bu yazıda meyvenin yaz mevsimini ve suyunu güneşte kurutup cemid yapma geleneğini anlatıyoruz; yıllık El-Ahsa Lomi Sergisi için de bir rehber sunuyoruz."
items.en_before: description: "Meet the Hasawi lime (lomi), Al-Ahsa's second crop after dates: its summer season, the jameed sun-drying tradition, and a guide to the annual Lomi Exhibition."
items.en_after: description: "Meet the Hasawi lime (lomi), Al-Ahsa's second crop after dates: its summer season, the sun-aged jameed tradition, and a guide to the annual Lomi Exhibition."
items.ar: description: "تعرّف على الليمون الأحسائي (اللومي) ثمرة الأحساء الثانية بعد التمور: صفاته وموسمه الصيفي، وعادة الجميد، ودليلك إلى معرض اللومي الحساوي السنوي."

items.current: a: "Cemid güneşte kurutulup bekletilmiş misket limonu suyudur. Onu hazırlamak sevilen bir El-Ahsa geleneğidir: aileler yaz mevsiminde bir araya gelip misket limonunu (lomi) sıkar, suyu güneşte kurutur ve cam kavanozlarda bekletir. Cemid böylece bütün yıl kullanılır."
items.en_before: a: "It is sun-dried lime juice: a cherished Hasawi custom in which families gather in the summer season to press the lomi, then sun-dry and age the juice in glass jars as a supply used throughout the year."
items.en_after: a: "It is lime juice aged in the sun: a cherished Hasawi custom in which families gather in the summer season to press the lomi, then set the juice in the sun and age it in glass jars as a supply used throughout the year."
items.ar: a: "هو عصير اللومي المشمّس: عادة أحسائية أصيلة تجتمع فيها الأسر في موسم الصيف لعصر اللومي، ثم يُشمَّس العصير ويُعتَّق في أوعية زجاجية ليكون مؤونة تُستعمل على مدار العام."

items.ar: ## من الشجرة إلى المؤونة: الجميد وعصير اللومي المشمّس

items.current: Lominin etrafında El-Ahsa'ya özgü, çok sevilen bir yaz geleneği vardır: mevsiminde aileler bir araya gelip lomiyi sıkar ve suyunu bütün yıl yetecek kadar saklar. Bu ürüne **“cemid”** denir: güneşte kurutulup cam kavanozlarda bekletilmiş misket limonu suyu. Lomi taze olarak, sıkılmış suyuyla ve kurutulmuş meyve olarak kullanılır; kurutulmuş lomi yıl boyunca El-Ahsa'nın ve Arap Körfezi bölgesinin yemeklerine aroma katar.
items.en_before: A cherished Hasawi summer custom surrounds the lomi: in its season, families gather to press and preserve it — the practice known as **"jameed"**: lime juice sun-dried and aged in glass jars — laying in a supply for the whole year. It is used fresh, as juice, and dried, perfuming the dishes of Hasawi and Arabian Gulf cooking all year round.
items.en_after: A cherished Hasawi summer custom surrounds the lomi: in its season, families gather to press and preserve it — the practice known as **"jameed"**: lime juice set in the sun and aged in glass jars — laying in a supply for the whole year. It is used fresh, as juice, and dried, perfuming the dishes of Hasawi and Arabian Gulf cooking all year round.
items.ar: ترتبط باللومي عادة أحسائية صيفية أصيلة: تجتمع الأسر في موسمه لعصره وتخزينه — فيما يُعرف بـ«الجميد»: عصير اللومي المشمّس المعتّق في أوعية زجاجية — ليكون مؤونة العام كله. فيُستعمل طازجاً، وعصيراً، ومجففاً يعطّر أطباق المطبخ الأحسائي والخليجي على مدار السنة.

items.current: Öyleyse iki vahaya ne kalıyor? Bir köken iddiasından daha değerli bir şey kalıyor: yüzyıllar süren yerel tarımsal seçilim; kendine özgü bir mikro iklim yaratan sulama sistemi ve hurma gölgesi; budama, güneşte kurutma ve bekletme konusunda atalardan kalan bilgi birikimi; ve cemid (güneşte kurutulup bekletilmiş misket limonu suyu) geleneğiyle taçlanan bütün bir mutfak kültürü. Bir vahanın kendine özgülüğü bunun üzerine kurulur; ağacın nereden geldiği üzerine değil.
items.en_before: So what remains for the two oases? Something worth more than a claim of origin: centuries of local agricultural selection, an irrigation system and palm shade that created a microclimate of their own, inherited know-how in pruning, sun-drying and ageing, and a complete food culture crowned by the custom of jameed. That is what distinction is built on, not the tree of origin.
items.en_after: So what remains for the two oases? That is what distinction is built on, not the tree of origin.
items.ar: فماذا يبقى للواحتين؟ يبقى ما هو أثمن من ادعاء الأصل: قرون من الانتخاب الزراعي المحلي، ومنظومة ري وظلال نخيل صنعت مناخاً خاصاً، ومعارف متوارثة في التقليم والتشميس والتعتيق، وثقافة استهلاك كاملة تتوّجها عادة «الجميد». هذا ما يُبنى عليه التميّز، لا شجرة الأصل.

items.current: Kültürel düzeyde ise El-Ahsa aileleri her yaz misket limonunu sıkıp saklamak için bir araya gelir; bunun en görünür biçimi cemiddir: güneşte kurutulup cam kavanozlarda bekletilmiş lomi suyu, bütün yıl kullanılır. Bu gelenek kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılmıştır ([Akhbaar 24](https://www.akhbaar24.com/article/detail/615953)). Kutlama o kadar büyüdü ki meyvenin kendi yıllık [El-Ahsa Lomi Sergisi](/tr/events/hasawi-lomi-exhibition/) var; meyveyi ağaçtan toplamak da artık [El-Ahsa Misket Limonu Çiftliği](/tr/attractions/lemon-farm/)'nde ziyaretçilerin katılabildiği bir etkinlik.
items.en_before: Culturally, Hasawi families gather every summer to press and store the lime, most visibly as jameed: lomi juice sun-dried and aged in glass jars for use all year round, a custom handed down through the generations ([Akhbaar 24](https://www.akhbaar24.com/article/detail/615953)). The celebration has grown to the point that the fruit has its own annual [Hasawi Lomi Exhibition](/en/events/hasawi-lomi-exhibition/), and picking it from the tree has become a visitor experience at the [Hasawi Lemon Farm](/en/attractions/lemon-farm/).
items.en_after: Culturally, Hasawi families gather every summer to press and store the lime, most visibly as jameed: lomi juice set in the sun and aged in glass jars for use all year round, a custom handed down through the generations ([Akhbaar 24](https://www.akhbaar24.com/article/detail/615953)). The celebration has grown to the point that the fruit has its own annual [Hasawi Lomi Exhibition](/en/events/hasawi-lomi-exhibition/), and picking it from the tree has become a visitor experience at the [Hasawi Lemon Farm](/en/attractions/lemon-farm/).
items.ar: وعلى المستوى الثقافي، تجتمع الأسر الأحسائية كل صيف لعصر الليمون وتخزينه، وأبرز صور ذلك «الجميد»: عصير اللومي المشمّس والمعتّق في أوعية زجاجية للاستخدام طوال العام، وهي عادة موروثة جيلاً بعد جيل ([أخبار 24](https://www.akhbaar24.com/article/detail/615953)). وبلغ الاحتفاء بالثمرة أن أُفرد لها [معرض اللومي الحساوي](/فعاليات/معرض-اللومي-الحساوي/) السنوي، وأن صار قطفها من شجرتها تجربة سياحية في [مزرعة الليمون الحساوي](/معالم/مزرعة-الليمون-الحساوي/).

items.current: pre: 'Misket limonu (lomi), hurmadan sonra El-Ahsa\'nın ikinci ürünüdür. Meyvesi küçük, koyu yeşil ve ince kabukludur; suyla dolup taşar. Tadı çok ekşidir; keskin kokusu onu diğer tüm narenciyelerden ayırır. Vahaya yayılmış, meyve veren 100.000\'den fazla misket limonu ağacı vardır. Bir ağaçtan bir mevsimde 25–30 kg ürün alınır. Misket limonuyla ilgili, El-Ahsa\'da sevilen bir yaz âdeti de vardır. Aileler bir araya gelip meyveyi sıkar ve suyunu yıl boyu kullanmak üzere saklar. Bu ürüne “cemid” denir: güneşte kurutulup bekletilmiş misket limonu suyu. Misket limonu her yıl El-Ahsa Lomi Sergisi\'yle kutlanır. Sergiyi El-Ahsa Ticaret Odası ile El-Ahsa Geliştirme Kurumu birlikte düzenler.',
items.en_before: pre: 'Al-Ahsa\'s second crop after dates. A small, dark-green, thin-skinned fruit bursting with juice, sharply tart with a piercing fragrance that sets it apart from all other citrus. More than 100,000 bearing lime trees spread across the oasis; a single tree yields 25–30 kg a season. A cherished Hasawi summer custom surrounds it: families gather to press and preserve it (“jameed”: lime juice sun-dried and aged) for use all year. The governorate celebrates it annually at the Hasawi Lomi Exhibition, organised by the Al-Ahsa Chamber in partnership with the Al-Ahsa Development Authority.',
items.en_after: pre: 'Al-Ahsa\'s second crop after dates. A small, dark-green, thin-skinned fruit bursting with juice, sharply tart with a piercing fragrance that sets it apart from all other citrus. The governorate celebrates it annually at the Hasawi Lomi Exhibition, organised by the Al-Ahsa Chamber in partnership with the Al-Ahsa Development Authority.',
items.ar: pre: 'المنتج الزراعي الثاني في الأحساء بعد التمور. ثمرته صغيرة خضراء داكنة رقيقة القشرة غزيرة العصير، بطعم حمضي قوي ورائحة عطرية نفّاذة تميّزه عن سائر الحمضيات. تنتشر في الواحة أكثر من 100 ألف شجرة لومي مثمرة؛ إذ تنتج الشجرة الواحدة ما بين 25 و30 كيلوغراماً في الموسم. وترتبط به عادة أحسائية صيفية أصيلة: تجتمع الأسر لعصره وتخزينه («الجميد»: عصير اللومي المشمّس المعتّق) لاستعماله طوال العام. وتحتفي به المحافظة سنوياً في «معرض اللومي الحساوي» الذي تنظمه غرفة الأحساء بالشراكة مع هيئة تطوير الأحساء.',
